title: Archive Manager
description: PROGRAM: Archive Manager (['record validator', 'lineage chain', 'seed generator']). Manages archive records: validates, links lineage, and generates deterministic filler IDs. This record IS the complete runnable program — copy it to a file and run with python3.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""SIGNATURE MASTER: archive manager (validate + lineage + seeded ids)."""
import re
def prng(seed):
    a=seed&0xFFFFFFFF
    def n():
        nonlocal a
        a=(a+0x6D2B79F5)&0xFFFFFFFF
        t=a; t=((t^(t>>15))*(t|1))&0xFFFFFFFF
        return ((t^(t>>14))&0xFFFFFFFF)/4294967296
    return n
class Manager:
    def __init__(self): self.recs={}; self.parent={}
    def add(self,rec,parent=None):
        assert re.match(r"^JAH-[A-Z]+-\d+$",rec["id"]) and rec["ladder_rank"] in (1,2,3)
        self.recs[rec["id"]]=rec
        if parent: self.parent[rec["id"]]=parent
    def children_of(self,pid): return [c for c,p in self.parent.items() if p==pid]

if __name__ == "__main__":
    m=Manager()
    m.add({"id":"JAH-REC-000001","ladder_rank":1})
    m.add({"id":"JAH-REC-000002","ladder_rank":2},parent="JAH-REC-000001")
    assert m.children_of("JAH-REC-000001")==["JAH-REC-000002"]
    r=prng(5); assert r()==prng(5)()
    print("OK: archive manager validates, links, and seeds")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""SIGNATURE MASTER: random lab (seeded flips + shuffles)."""
import random
def prng(seed):
    a=seed&0xFFFFFFFF
    def n():
        nonlocal a
        a=(a+0x6D2B79F5)&0xFFFFFFFF
        t=a; t=((t^(t>>15))*(t|1))&0xFFFFFFFF
        return ((t^(t>>14))&0xFFFFFFFF)/4294967296
    return n
def shuffle_seq(seq,seed):
    r=random.Random(seed); s=list(seq); r.shuffle(s); return s

if __name__ == "__main__":
    r1,r2=prng(9),prng(9)
    assert [r1() for _ in range(3)]==[r2() for _ in range(3)]
    s1,s2=shuffle_seq("abcdef",3),shuffle_seq("abcdef",3)
    assert s1==s2 and sorted(s1)==list("abcdef")
    print("stream + shuffle reproduce from seed")
    print("OK: random lab deterministic")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""SIGNATURE MASTER: decision tools (coin + countdown + RPS)."""
import random
BEATS={"rock":"scissors","scissors":"paper","paper":"rock"}
def flip(rng): return "heads" if rng.random()<0.5 else "tails"
def tiebreak(a,b,rng):
    ma,mb=rng.choice(list(BEATS)),rng.choice(list(BEATS))
    if ma==mb: return tiebreak(a,b,rng)
    return a if BEATS[ma]==mb else b

if __name__ == "__main__":
    rng=random.Random(21)
    print("coin:",flip(rng))
    winner=tiebreak("Alice","Bob",rng)
    print("RPS tiebreak winner:",winner)
    assert winner in ("Alice","Bob")
    assert [i for i in range(3,0,-1)]==[3,2,1]
    print("OK: decision tools verified")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""SIGNATURE MASTER: fun pack (hangman + scramble + pig + RPS + coin)."""
import random
def hangman(w,g): return set(w)<=set(x for x in g if x in w)
VOW=set("aeiou")
def pig(w):
    i=0
    while i<len(w) and w[i] not in VOW: i+=1
    return w[i:]+w[:i]+"ay"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    rng=random.Random(77)
    assert hangman("fun",["f","u","n"])
    assert pig("fun")=="unfay"
    assert sum(rng.random()<0.5 for _ in range(1000)) in range(400,601)
    print("hangman: won | pig latin: unfay | coin: fair")
    print("OK: fun pack verified")
